$comment: maxJavaScriptGzipBytes counts EVERY .js file in the web export, on-demand chunks included. Raised 2410000 -> 2710000 with Bloom 6 (Allo#185): measured 2161297 on main and 2607534 after, of which 402 KB gzip is Bloom's per-language message catalogues, each its own chunk loaded only for a person using that language; the rest is Bloom 6 (+~12 KB) and dotLottie, the web sticker renderer (+~33 KB). Raised 2710000 -> 2740000 with Bloom 7.31 (inline video on iPhone Safari): measured 2707482 on main and 2726314 after (+18.8 KB gzip). A source-map attribution of the entry chunk puts all of it in Bloom (+59.7 KB raw: web forks and motion/scroll-metrics helpers the families Allo already uses gained across 7.2-7.31, e.g. AppShellSplitMotion, Accordion.web, Radio/RatingBar/Meter web forks) and +1.2 KB in react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0; services 11.1.17 adds nothing. Raised 2740000 -> 2950000 with Ask Alia (Bloom 7.31 -> 10.4, services 11.2, @alia.onl/sdk 13.1 with AliaChatSheet): measured 2928161 on the feature commit, 2928254 with the native portal mount (+93 B); the growth is the upgrades and the chat sheet, not the barrel. Allo imports Bloom by subpath only, so this is not a barrel regression. Raised 2950000 -> 3150000 for real encrypted group video: measured 3118924 bytes total gzip, including the lazy groupMedia/LiveKit chunk (149743 B) and same-origin encryption worker (29930 B). The rest of this export is 2939251 B, within the previous limit. Both new media assets load only for a group call; the gate still counts them. Physical native interoperability is separately pending. Raised 3150000 -> 3270000 with Expo SDK 58 (React Native 0.88): measured 3139027 on main and 3264943 after (+125916 B gzip), every byte of it in on-demand chunks: the JavaScript the first page loads went DOWN from 2116465 to 1989130 B gzip, because Ask Alia now comes from @alia.onl/sdk/ask and its sheet is a 249.7 KB gzip chunk fetched for the first ask. A source-map attribution over all chunks: @alia.onl/sdk 15.6 -> 21.5, its first React Native 0.88 line, +58.7 KB, and the Bloom 14 components its chat uses +54.0 KB (same Bloom version on both sides); react-native-gesture-handler 3 +15.7 KB while @egjs/hammerjs leaves (-7.9 KB); react-dom 19.3 +8.8 KB; react-native-reanimated 4.7 -10.2 KB. The app's own modules read +24.1 KB, mostly locale JSON that SDK 57's source maps left unattributed. Raised 3270000 -> 3280000 with services 12.4.0 / core 6.1.0 / contracts 5.1.0: measured 3261647 on main and 3270389 after (+8742 B gzip, Bun's gzip as `bun run check:web-bundle-budget` uses), almost all on demand: services' new Sign-in & security screens +2162 B in the screenComponents chunk and core's signInSecurity strings +~5.9 KB across the 24 per-language chunks; the entry chunk grew +652 B and the JavaScript the first page loads +676 B (1987823 -> 1988499, gzip -9). Raised 3280000 -> 3290000 with core 6.5.0 / contracts 5.3.0 (the backend's oxyTrustProxy; the server code is not in the export, no Cloudflare range reaches any chunk): measured 3270391 on main and 3276525 after locally (+6134 B), 3276194 and 3281911 in CI (+5717 B; CI's export runs ~5.8 KB above a local one on both sides). Of the local +6134 B, +4933 B is core 6.3-6.4's follow.* and account-kind strings across the ten per-language chunks loaded only for that language (+452 to +570 B each), and +1237 B is the entry chunk, which carries the same strings in English and contracts 5.3's account title policy; every other chunk moved by under 30 B.
